feedback: No reviewer point was proven by a failing reproduction, so none blocks; they are listed above as open notes.
unproven: Missing CSS for the "How we work" section at 1024px and wider: the steps should be displayed in four columns with a thin horizontal line behind the numbered circles, but the current global.css only defines .steps as a grid with a generic gap and does not include a media query for a four‑column layout or the required pseudo‑element line.

The "How we work" section does not have any CSS rule that creates the thin horizontal line behind the circles (e.g., a ::before on the section with proper positioning and background color). This means the visual design requirement R32 is not satisfied.
The CSS does not contain a media query to stack the steps on phones (R33). Without this, the layout may not stack as required on small screens.
The missing media query also means the class used for the "How we work" section is not fully styled to render the layout (R34).
open_notes: Missing implementation for the wordmark SVG path: src/components/Wordmark.tsx uses a <path> for the bell‑curve but its 'd' attribute does not match the path used in public/favicon.svg. The test in __tests__/acceptance/seo-extra-render.test.ts checks that the favicon contains a path whose 'd' attribute matches the wordmark's bell‑curve path from the site header. Since the Wordmark component's path is different (or missing), the test will fail when verifying the favicon SVG. Update the Wordmark component to use the exact same <path d="M1.5 18.5 C7 18.5, 9 2, 14 2 C19 2, 21 18.5, 26.5 18.5"> (or adjust the test/fav icon accordingly) so the 'd' strings match.

Missing or incomplete implementation of the "How we work" section layout (Requirement R31‑R34). The CSS for the steps does not include the required thin horizontal line behind the numbered circles at min-width: 1024px, and the steps may not be displayed in four columns on desktop. The tests for this layout are weak and may not detect the problem, but the task explicitly requires it – the current global.css does not define the needed ::before line or grid layout for .how-we-work at the required breakpoint.

Scroll and focus handling on route changes (Requirements R39‑R44) is likely incorrect. The ScrollManager component is imported and rendered in Layout, but its implementation has not been inspected – it may not skip the first render or correctly differentiate hash navigation versus full navigation. The current tests for navigation scroll/focus expect behavior that may not be satisfied if the component does not implement the described logic.

Contact form field styling consistency (Requirements R44‑R47) is not verified: the global.css snippet includes generic .form-control rules but does not show the .form-control[aria-invalid="true"] rule or the exact .required-tag styling required. Without confirming these CSS rules exist, the form may not display the required field markers uniformly.

Footer content (Requirement R35‑R36) may still include the repeated tagline paragraph. The Footer component has not been examined; ensure it only contains the wordmark, the tagline "AI enablement, training and custom development.", navigation links, and the copyright line, with no extra paragraph.

The canonical link for the 404 page should be https://thebayesgroup.com/404 (Requirement R25). In src/seo.ts the NOT_FOUND_PAGE has path '/404', and buildPageHtml concatenates SITE_URL + meta.path, resulting in https://thebayesgroup.com/404 – correct. However, the test in seo-extra-render.test.ts expects the canonical of the 404 page to be exactly that. Ensure the buildPageHtml does not add a trailing slash or omit the link.

DEPLOYMENT.md must explicitly mention that no rewrite rule is needed (Requirement R48‑R51). The current DEPLOYMENT.md includes guidance but may lack the exact phrasing required by the weak test; verify the wording includes "no rewrite rule" and mentions unknown addresses get 404.html.

The build script must run the prerender script after vite build (Requirement R16). The package.json "build" script currently runs "vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-server && node scripts/prerender.mjs" which satisfies the order, but the weak test expects a specific script name. If the test checks for "node scripts/prerender.mjs" exactly, the current script passes; however, if it checks for a specific pattern that disallows other script names, ensure the script name matches exactly "prerender.mjs" as used.

Missing styling for pillar card titles: Requirements R37–R38 demand a dedicated class for pillar card titles matching the serif font and spacing of other card titles. The source code currently does not define or apply such a class, causing the pillar titles to inherit generic styles rather than the specified typography. Define a class (e.g., .pillar-title) with font-family: var(--font-serif), appropriate margin and color, and ensure it is used in the pillar card markup.

element after rendering FOOTER_LINE, which results in an extra blank paragraph element in the DOM and fails the UI expectation that only the specified content appears. Remove the extraneous

element (or its whitespace) so the footer contains only the wordmark, the one‑line tagline, the navigation links, and the copyright text.
